summary: First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of a material definitive agreement. On April 29, 2026, its subsidiary purchased three properties from FGB Partners for $14.77 million cash, ending the sale-leaseback and lease agreements entered in June 2024. The transaction is a routine property repurchase with related parties; no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. The filing solely covers the termination of lease agreements, not a broader strategic event. No deal terms of the type sought are stated.
